metrics.name: Readability & sentence length
metrics.evidence: Approximate English Flesch score 31; 12 words per sentence.
metrics.fix: Split difficult sentences where clarity improves; confirm with editorial review.

metrics.name: Content depth & coverage
metrics.evidence: 59 approximate English words in fetched main text. Length alone does not establish topic completeness.
metrics.fix: Review whether the page answers its intended audience’s questions; do not pad short utility pages.

metrics.name: Paragraph transitions
metrics.evidence: 1 transition phrase matches. This is not a model behavior measurement.
metrics.fix: Use transitions where they clarify the argument, not to satisfy a keyword quota.

metrics.name: Related-topic coverage
metrics.evidence: Not measured. Requires a defined topic/reference corpus or a configured semantic evaluator.
metrics.fix: Use a topic-specific editorial review. No semantic coverage claim is made.

metrics.name: Standalone answer passages
metrics.evidence: 1 paragraphs contain 40–250 whitespace-separated words. Completeness is not verified.
metrics.fix: Write self-contained answers appropriate to the question; no universal word-count sweet spot is assumed.

metrics.name: Numeric detail
metrics.evidence: 0 numeric strings found. Their accuracy and sources were not verified.
metrics.fix: Support meaningful statistics with evidence; avoid adding numbers solely for scoring.

metrics.name: Non-promotional tone
metrics.evidence: 0 promotional-word matches. Neutral tone does not guarantee citations.
metrics.fix: Replace unsupported superlatives with specific, substantiated statements.

metrics.name: Heading hierarchy
metrics.evidence: 2 headings; 1 H1(s). No skipped levels detected.
metrics.fix: Use a clear main heading and coherent heading structure.

metrics.name: Q&A and definition signals
metrics.evidence: 0 question/FAQ heading(s). Definition detection is a text heuristic.
metrics.fix: Answer genuine customer questions directly where it suits the page.

metrics.name: Image alt attributes
metrics.evidence: 0 of 0 images lack an alt attribute. Empty alt may be correct for decorative images.
metrics.fix: Provide useful alternative text for meaningful images; manually review descriptive quality.

metrics.name: Cross-platform extraction testing
metrics.evidence: Not measured. No live ChatGPT, Perplexity or Gemini response tests were run.
metrics.fix: Use a separately configured, repeatable prompt-monitoring system for actual answer/citation measurements.

metrics.name: Structured content formats
metrics.evidence: 0 list/table element(s) found; suitability for page intent is not verified.
metrics.fix: Use lists, steps and tables only where they help readers.

metrics.name: Sentence clarity signals
metrics.evidence: Average 12 English words per sentence. Active voice and entity ambiguity are not measured.
metrics.fix: Review long sentences and ambiguous references manually.

metrics.name: Search-crawler robots permission
metrics.evidence: OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot are not disallowed for this path.
metrics.fix: Review search-bot permissions against your publishing policy; never blindly allow training or private paths.

metrics.name: Parseable JSON-LD
metrics.evidence: 0 parseable JSON-LD block(s), 0 invalid. Schema.org compliance and truthfulness are not validated.
metrics.fix: Use accurate markup matching visible content, then validate it with the relevant schema tools.

metrics.name: Sitemap membership
metrics.evidence: URL found in the discovered sitemap set.
metrics.fix: Include canonical public URLs in a valid sitemap; inspect navigation depth separately.

metrics.name: Initial HTML text availability
metrics.evidence: 59 English words in initial HTML. Browser rendering, loading speed and Core Web Vitals were not tested.
metrics.fix: Ensure useful content is accessible to relevant crawlers; use a performance tool for speed measurements.

metrics.name: Declared update date
metrics.evidence: No supported explicit update-date declaration found. Not every page requires a date.
metrics.fix: Declare truthful update dates when relevant; never change dates without substantive updates.

metrics.name: External source links
metrics.evidence: 1 unique external HTTPS link(s). Source authority and claim support were not verified.
metrics.fix: Cite relevant primary evidence where claims need support; domain suffix alone is not proof of authority.

metrics.name: Author and organization declarations
metrics.evidence: No supported author/organization declaration found.
metrics.fix: Identify responsible authors or organizations and use genuine credentials.

metrics.name: sameAs entity declarations
metrics.evidence: 0 sameAs declaration(s). Entity accuracy and external identities are not verified.
metrics.fix: Link only genuine matching official profiles in relevant structured data.

metrics.name: Internal topic linking signals
metrics.evidence: 0 unique internal HTTPS links. Topical authority and relevance are not established.
metrics.fix: Connect genuinely related resources with descriptive links; do not overlink for a score.

framework: AEOGEO 22-point framework, version 1; not a university certification or validated AI visibility measure.
limitations: Scores combine measured HTML checks with explicitly labeled editorial heuristics. Unknown checks are excluded, not marked Pass.
Related-topic coverage and cross-platform AI extraction are not measured in this build. No actual assistant citations or ranking positions are collected.
Initial HTML only. JavaScript is not rendered. English readability heuristics are not reliable for other languages.
The simulator changes this checklist score under stated assumptions; it does not forecast citations, rankings, traffic or revenue.
source: Separate fictional fixture analyzed with the same engine; not a live competitor crawl.
